checks.name: Actual Prisma connection role is limited and has no RLS bypass
Patient, doctor, assistant and admin see only their own notifications
Foreign update denied; own read flag update allowed
Column privileges prevent notification ownership transfer
Push INSERT/UPDATE WITH CHECK prevents changing owner; foreign read denied
80 concurrent transactions with pool size 2 do not leak context
Deactivated identity is denied by policy
Worker can insert notifications and purge expired only; cannot register devices
RLS and FORCE RLS enabled on both pilot tables
Rollback tested without removing any records
